additions.name: UFINET Transístmica, Panama City — existing colocation operations

status.summary: An active commercial service filing dated September 23, 2026 identifies UFINET Transístmica. UFINET identifies the same property in its colocation portfolio.

locator.precision: Representative point for the commercial host property at PH NYSO. The data center occupies only part of the property.
locator.identity_review: UFINET’s commercial page and registered address identify Complejo PH NYSO. Panama’s commercial-premises register and a storefront directory independently identify the mapped Super Xtra property on Transístmica as that complex.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The mapped host-property polygon has no published numerical positional accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Six baseline layers were checked for the property and operator aliases. The nearest confirmed location is Tigo Panamá IDC Clayton, 6347 metres away. The operator’s other Panama City presence at Victoria Plaza is a different commercial property.
additions.successor_review: The facility registration and the company’s colocation offering use Transístmica for the same physical property at PH NYSO.

additions.name: Hanam Data Center — existing colocation operations

status.summary: Macquarie reported third-quarter revenue from Hanam Data Center as operations ramped up in the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

locator.method: Area centroid of OpenStreetMap way 1236581232 version 6 in EPSG:5179, transformed to WGS 84.
locator.precision: Representative point within the mapped commercial data-center building.
locator.identity_review: The mapped building has the Hanam Data Center name, ten aboveground floors and the former IGIS name. The sale adviser identifies the IGIS property, the project record gives the lots and floor area, and the national address register matches lot 607-2 to its civic address.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The mapped building footprint carries no measured positional accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: The former IGIS name, property address and national building ID resolve to one property. No canonical project, site, source record or evidence entry matched its aliases. The nearest prior site is 14.5 km away.
additions.successor_review: The fund reports operational ramp-up at the existing site in the third quarter. Its later full-rent forecast concerns the same property.

additions.name: ETIX Paris #3 — existing operations

status.summary: On October 23 Clever Cloud reported that it had put a new service into operation at ETIX Paris #3 in Vélizy-Villacoublay.

locator.method: Use the Base Adresse Nationale house-number point for 16 avenue de l’Europe in Vélizy-Villacoublay.
locator.precision: Public street address of the ETIX Paris #3 campus.
locator.identity_review: The operator gives 16–18 avenue de l’Europe for Paris #3. The establishment register names ETIX Everywhere France at the same 16–18 range and the municipality records works for ETIX at number 16.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address register gives no measured positional error for this numbered address.

additions.distinctness_review: The nearest recorded property, NDC Paris 1 on avenue Morane Saulnier, has a separate address. The ETIX Paris #3 directory also distinguishes Paris #1 and #2.
additions.successor_review: ETIX confirmed additional IT capacity at the existing Paris #3 site on November 24 and distinguished the planned Paris #4 development.

additions.name: ETIX Lille #4 — existing operations

status.summary: On November 10 ETIX reported that Lille #4 remained in operation and maintained service for existing customers throughout its expansion.

locator.method: Compute the centroid of the Fretin cadastral parcel in Lambert-93 and transform the result to WGS 84.
locator.precision: Representative point on the Fretin parcel of the permitted two-commune property.
locator.identity_review: The prefecture names ETIX Lille 4 at 317 rue des Famards. Two Sitadel decisions at that address name the same applicant and parcels. The operator directory names Lille #4 on the same street at number 28. The permit parcel supplies the campus locator.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral release gives no measured positional error for this parcel. The point represents the campus property across its phases.

additions.distinctness_review: The ETIX operator directory distinguishes Lille #4 at rue des Famards in Fretin from Lille #2 at 1681 rue des Saules in Sainghin-en-Mélantois, the nearest published campus. ETIX also markets #2 and #4 together as one campus. The locations have separate numbered facility identities and permitted properties. The completed increment belongs to Lille #4.
additions.successor_review: The November 10 commissioning report distinguishes the original operating site and its completed 500 kW IT phase from a subsequent 1 MW phase. The November 24 operator announcement also describes further investment at Lille #4 and separate plans for Lille #5.
additions.site_identity_review: ETIX describes existing customer service at Lille #4, the same named property where it commissioned a separate IT capacity increment.

additions.name: Google Changhua County Data Center — existing campus operations

status.summary: At an August 31 forum, Google’s Asia-Pacific energy infrastructure executive described operations at the Changbin data center in Changhua and reported a trailing 12-month PUE of 1.13.

locator.method: Centroid of the named OpenStreetMap property in TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 (EPSG:3826), transformed to WGS 84 and checked inside the mapped property.
locator.precision: Representative point within the established Google campus property in the Changbin industrial park, Xianxi.
locator.identity_review: The industrial park identifies the Xianxi district as the site of Google’s 2013 opening. The mapped property gives the facility name and links directly to the operator’s Changhua County campus profile.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OpenStreetMap gives no measured positional uncertainty. The bounds of later expansions are unspecified.

additions.distinctness_review: No prior site, project, evidence or source record matched the campus names or property. The nearest prior site is Chunghwa Telecom Hsinchu Zhubei IDC, 96.8 km away.
additions.successor_review: Google’s campus history identifies subsequent construction as phased expansion of the existing campus. The August presentation describes its continuing operation. The operator’s public efficiency tables distinguish this Changhua County reporting campus from other regions.

operating_model_updates.identity_review: UFINET names Transístmica as a commercial data center, locates it at PH NYSO, and advertises space at that facility.
The asset profile explicitly calls this specific property a hyperscale colocation facility.

The ETIX client reporting workbook names Paris #3 in its list of properties for occupied customer racks, cages and suites. Its commercial customer also reported operating its own servers in the new Paris-region zones, including ETIX Paris #3 at Vélizy.
Google records buying the Changhua land, designing and opening its own data center for its services, and later expanding the same campus.
